# circuit-breaker

> Context-first circuit breaker with closed, open and half-open states plus a bulkhead concurrency limiter and metrics snapshot, stdlib only. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u046-circuit-breaker`, package `circuitbreaker`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, API summary, limits
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
